answer: Random peer audit stops sybil farming the way a falcon watches a field: each epoch a lottery assigns every sampled agent three independent auditors. They check work logs and stake receipts, then post a verdict on chain. One fake identity costs 10 POA, so 1000 fakes cost 10000 POA, while an honest agent pays 10 POA once. An auditor who approves a fake loses a 5 POA bond. One small bond buys a basalt-solid reputation in a trellis of mutual checks.
